content:
alex: Observed steady memory growth on private-run Qwen-MQA jobs when contexts exceed ~120k tokens. KV Pager keeps allocating 'ghost' pages that never get reclaimed. Profiler snapshot attached.

maya: Can you paste the profiler snapshot? rough numbers please

alex: Paste:
```
KVPages: total=3420 active=2892 freed=528
pager.allocs/sec: 14.2
pager.sweep.time_ms: 1.2
frag_ratio: 0.34
peak_rss_delta: +1.9GB over 20m
```
Looks like active pages keep growing while frees lag.

dorian: Any recent kernel-selection changes on Qwen path? We changed small-block allocator heuristics last week.

alex: Yes, runtime switched to the 'packed' kernel for smaller attention kernels for Qwen. Hypothesis: packed kernels don't align pages the same and cause fragmentation under MQA (multi-query) KV layout.

ciara: Also note rope scaling differences between Llama and Qwen -> Llama uses per-layer scaling that keeps offsets stable; Qwen's dynamic rope leads to KV reuse mismatches.

maya: Repro steps? we need a minimal repro to try compaction fix.

alex: Repro: run long-chat harness with Qwen-MQA checkpoint and 200 concurrent prefills: `./bench --model qwen-mqa --context 200k --concurrency 200 --duration 20m`.
Profiling gcore shows many small allocations labelled KV-Page-Fragment.

perf-bot: CI alert: regression detected on `kv_pager_reclaim` benchmark (master -> last-green) +12% tail latency. See CI#3421

dorian: Proposed fixes:
- revert packed kernel for Qwen (quick)
- add opportunistic compaction pass in pager when free/active < 0.2
- change pager.alloc threshold to consider rope-scaling factor

ciara: I ran a quick local patch: enabled compaction every 30s, results (20m run): peak_rss +300MB vs +1.9GB, tail latency unchanged. So compaction helps memory but doesn't fix reuse inefficiency.

maya: Could be GQA vs MQA layout difference: GQA stores per-head caches that fragment less. We should add per-model pager tuning: Qwen-MQA gets aggressive compaction + different small-alloc bucket.

alex: Also we see kernel selection flip at runtime when seq_len crosses 8192, which triggers reallocation of KV buffers. That churn + pager fragmentation = ghost pages. Need to stop hot-switching kernels mid-session or transfer KV without realloc.

dorian: I'll open a PR with two patches: (1) don't hot-switch kernels for active sessions, (2) compaction pass + threshold tuning. Will add test harness: long-context Qwen-MQA smoke.

alex: Thanks. If someone can run the long-chat harness on the dedicated infra (p4dn) with the patch, drop numbers here.

maya: tagging @eng-sre for infra run later tonight :eyes:

ciara: Nice investigative work. Also add a perf regression alert for memory growth on model-specific pager heuristics.

alex: ack, I'll follow up with a short run and paste results.
